title: PLUR1BUS harness config.json (schemaVersion 1)
description: Configuration for the PLUR1BUS harness process, its supervisor, and optional integrations.

$schema.description: URI identifying the JSON Schema used to validate this configuration.

schemaVersion.description: Configuration format version; this schema supports version 1.

hostctl.description: Local computer-control tools, gated by D109. No remote listener.

enabled.description: Register local hostctl tools.

allowed.description: Allow proc.shell after normal D109 approval.

default.description: Shell executable; set pwsh on Windows.

maxBytes.description: Maximum file content or retained process output bytes.

allow.description: Environment names eligible for inheritance; secrets and injection variables remain blocked.

denyPatterns.description: Additional case-insensitive literal command substrings to refuse.

core.description: Settings for the core process, including logging, memory operation budgets, and shutdown.

logLevel.description: Minimum severity written to the core log.

recall.description: Time and response-size limits for memory recall.

softBudgetMs.description: Soft target duration for a recall, in milliseconds.

hardBudgetMs.description: Maximum duration allowed for a recall before it is aborted, in milliseconds.

capChars.description: Maximum number of characters returned by a recall.

capture.description: Limits for waiting on memory capture after a turn.

waitMs.description: Maximum time to wait for a memory capture, in milliseconds.

shutdownBudgetMs.description: Maximum time the core spends on graceful shutdown, in milliseconds.

supervisor.description: Timing settings used by the process supervisor.

graceMs.description: Grace period given to a child process to exit during shutdown, in milliseconds.

healthIntervalMs.description: Interval between child-process health checks, in milliseconds.

metrics.description: D3: the read-only Prometheus text endpoint `GET /metrics` on a loopback address, protected by a bearer token kept in `state/metrics.token`.

enabled.description: Whether to expose the read-only Prometheus metrics endpoint.

port.description: Loopback port used by the metrics endpoint.

logs.description: Retention limits for rotating harness log files.

maxBytes.description: Maximum size of each log file before rotation, in bytes.

keep.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

agents.description: Per-agent settings keyed by a lowercase agent identifier.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the agent was created, in date-time format.

displayName.description: Optional human-readable name for the agent.

skills.description: Per-agent skill selection (X1-R11): `blocked` names skills this agent does not get although they are enabled installation-wide; `pinned` is stored and shown, not interpreted before D69; `applyAt` says when a change reaches a running agent.

blocked.description: Skill names this agent must not receive, even when enabled installation-wide.

pinned.description: Skill names pinned for this agent; currently stored and displayed but not interpreted.

applyAt.description: When a changed skill selection takes effect for a running agent.

mediaEmbedding.description: Per-agent override of the media index settings; unset keys inherit the installation values.

enabled.description: Whether the separate media index (image, video, audio) is used.

provider.description: Embedding provider id for the media index, or "off". Chosen independently of the text embedding provider.

model.description: Model id used for the media index; the same model may serve text and media, the indexes stay separate.

dimensions.description: Vector dimensions of the media index; must be supported by the model (EmbeddingGemma: 768, 512, 256 or 128).

video.description: How video is cut into segments and frames before embedding.

segmentSec.description: Length of one video segment in seconds.

maxFrames.description: Maximum number of frames embedded per video; capped by the model limit.

sceneDetect.description: Whether frames are picked at scene changes instead of a fixed interval.

audio.description: How audio is cut into segments before embedding.

segmentSec.description: Length of one audio segment in seconds.

maxSeconds.description: Maximum audio duration in seconds that is indexed; longer media is truncated.

caption.description: Captions: one text entry per medium in the text index, written by the prompt, the user or an automatic captioner.

source.description: Caption order: generation prompt, then user caption or alt text, then automatic captioning; user-only skips automatic captions; off disables captions.

provider.description: Caption provider id, or "off". Unset means local when the media embedding is local; with a cloud embedding setup asks.

perSegment.description: Whether video and audio get one caption per segment instead of one per medium.

backfill.description: Whether existing media are indexed automatically in the background (auto) or only on request (manual).

extensions.description: Extension management (X1-R21): whether unsigned packages may be installed, how many days uninstalled items stay in the trash, and the size caps for packages and skill folders.

allowUnsigned.description: Whether unsigned extension packages may be installed.

trashDays.description: Number of days uninstalled extensions are retained in the trash.

limits.description: Maximum unpacked sizes for extension packages and skill folders.

packageBytes.description: Maximum size of an extension package, in bytes.

skillBytes.description: Maximum size of an installed skill folder, in bytes.

embedding.description: Embedding model use classification and non-commercial licence acknowledgement.

useClass.description: Intended use of the embedding model: general, research, or commercial.

acceptedNcLicence.description: Whether the owner has accepted the model's non-commercial licence terms.

acceptedNcLicenceAt.description: Date-time when the non-commercial licence was accepted.

memory.description: Memory settings that the harness owns; the media index is separate from the text index.

mediaEmbedding.description: Media index (image, video, audio) with its own provider, independent of the text embedding. Captions land in the text index.

enabled.description: Whether the separate media index (image, video, audio) is used.

provider.description: Embedding provider id for the media index, or "off". Chosen independently of the text embedding provider.

model.description: Model id used for the media index; the same model may serve text and media, the indexes stay separate.

dimensions.description: Vector dimensions of the media index; must be supported by the model (EmbeddingGemma: 768, 512, 256 or 128).

video.description: How video is cut into segments and frames before embedding.

segmentSec.description: Length of one video segment in seconds.

maxFrames.description: Maximum number of frames embedded per video; capped by the model limit.

sceneDetect.description: Whether frames are picked at scene changes instead of a fixed interval.

audio.description: How audio is cut into segments before embedding.

segmentSec.description: Length of one audio segment in seconds.

maxSeconds.description: Maximum audio duration in seconds that is indexed; longer media is truncated.

caption.description: Captions: one text entry per medium in the text index, written by the prompt, the user or an automatic captioner.

source.description: Caption order: generation prompt, then user caption or alt text, then automatic captioning; user-only skips automatic captions; off disables captions.

provider.description: Caption provider id, or "off". Unset means local when the media embedding is local; with a cloud embedding setup asks.

perSegment.description: Whether video and audio get one caption per segment instead of one per medium.

backfill.description: Whether existing media are indexed automatically in the background (auto) or only on request (manual).

engine.description: Pass-through to the engine's EngineConfig (57 keys, see docs/config-engine-keys.md). Every key here is class core until the engine declares readAt: live (engine PR E5).

auth.description: Provider sign-in and credential lifecycle (D110): OAuth/PKCE login, federated tokens, refresh and the credential store.

openai.description: Sign in with ChatGPT and the other OpenAI credential routes (D110).

refreshSkewSeconds.description: Refresh before expiration, plus up to 15 seconds of jitter.

voiceDailySeconds.description: Per-person and per-agent daily voice ceiling.

voiceCapacity.description: Maximum concurrent voice sessions, no greater than the provider tier.

clientRegistration.description: OpenAI-issued registration per person and workspace; no borrowed client IDs.

storeBackend.description: Use the existing secret service. auto permits only its explicitly enabled encrypted-file fallback.

federated.description: External bearer supplier: one executable or file, explicit arguments and environment.

command.description: Executable that prints a fresh federated token as JSON on stdout (run without a shell). Mutually exclusive with file.

file.description: File holding the federated token and its expiry, re-read on refresh. Mutually exclusive with command.

args.description: Arguments passed to command, one array element per argument (no shell interpolation).

environment.description: Extra environment variables for command; only these and the built-in allowlist are passed.

decision.description: Reserved namespace for decision model configuration.

modelRoles.description: Model identifiers assigned to the supported functional roles.

additionalProperties.description: Model identifier assigned to the role.

modelProfiles.description: Named model profiles (C4): an ordered candidate list with weights for fallback or mixture-of-agents (moa) use, plus sampling parameters and cache hints. Data only; selection is the router's job. List order is priority order.

additionalProperties.description: Configuration for one named model profile.

strategy.description: How candidates are used: try in priority order (fallback) or combine them (moa).

candidates.description: Ordered model candidates; the first candidate has the highest priority.

items.description: A candidate model and its optional mixture weight.

weight.description: Relative contribution of this candidate when the moa strategy is used.

aggregator.description: Model identifier used to aggregate moa candidate outputs.

params.description: Sampling and output-size parameters for this profile.

topP.description: Nucleus-sampling probability threshold, greater than 0 and at most 1.

cache.description: Provider prompt-cache preference and optional time-to-live.

hint.description: Whether to use prompt caching automatically, never, or when preferred.

scan.description: Schedule for periodic local model discovery scans.

enabled.description: Whether periodic model discovery scans are enabled.

intervalHours.description: Hours between periodic model discovery scans.

secrets.description: Secret store (M2, ADR-005). The OS keyring is always tried first.

fileFallback.description: Settings for the encrypted-file secret-store fallback.

enabled.description: Use the encrypted file store (AES-256-GCM, machine-bound key file next to it) when the OS keyring is unavailable. Off until the owner decides ADR-005 Q3.

egress.description: Outgoing network policy (B4). Default deny: nothing is reachable until a host is listed. https only (plain http only to a listed loopback host when allowLoopback is on); private, link-local and metadata addresses are refused after name resolution whatever is listed.

allowHosts.description: Exact names, `*.suffix` (subdomains of any depth, not the apex), `*` (any name, never an IP literal) or an exact canonical IP literal (IPv6 in brackets).

allowPorts.description: Destination ports allowed for outgoing requests.

allowLoopback.description: Allow http(s) to loopback hosts (localhost, 127.0.0.0/8, ::1) that are also listed in allowHosts. A public name that resolves to loopback stays refused.

channels.description: Switchboard channel adapters. Every channel is off by default and takes effect when its module restarts. Tokens and passwords are secret names, never values.

discord.description: Discord channel adapter (Gateway + REST, slash commands, button approvals).

enabled.description: Whether the discord channel is started. Off by default; nothing connects until this is true.

tokenSecret.description: Name of the secret holding the Discord bot token. The value never appears in config or logs.

applicationId.description: Discord application id (needed to register slash commands). Taken from the gateway READY event when omitted.

intents.description: Gateway intents to request. MESSAGE_CONTENT is privileged and must also be enabled in the developer portal.

allowlist.description: Guild channel, thread or DM channel ids that may talk to the bot. Empty allows nothing, inbound and outbound.

dmAllowlist.description: Sender ids that may write to the bot in a direct message. Empty allows no direct messages.

userAllowlist.description: When present, only these senders are heard in groups. Also names the senders that need no mention under replyPolicy `allowlist`.

replyPolicy.description: When the bot answers in a group: `mention` only when addressed or replied to, `always` every message of an allowed chat, `allowlist` every message from userAllowlist members and the rest only when addressed. Direct messages are always answered when allowed.

maxMediaBytes.description: Largest attachment accepted or sent, in bytes (checked before and during download and before upload).

locale.description: Language of the bot's own messages (pairing replies, refusals, approval prompts).

slack.description: Slack channel adapter (Socket Mode, Web API, Block Kit approvals). No public endpoint is needed.

enabled.description: Whether the slack channel is started. Off by default; nothing connects until this is true.

botTokenSecret.description: Name of the secret holding the Slack bot token (xoxb-…).

appTokenSecret.description: Name of the secret holding the Slack app-level token (xapp-…) with the connections:write scope, used for Socket Mode.

teamId.description: Slack workspace id; events from other workspaces are ignored when set.

allowlist.description: Slack channel, group or conversation ids that may talk to the bot. Empty allows nothing, inbound and outbound.

dmAllowlist.description: Sender ids that may write to the bot in a direct message. Empty allows no direct messages.

locale.description: Language of the bot's own messages (pairing replies, refusals, approval prompts).

matrix.description: Matrix channel adapter (client-server API, sync loop, reactions as approvals). Rooms with end-to-end encryption are refused in this version.

enabled.description: Whether the matrix channel is started. Off by default; nothing connects until this is true.

homeserverUrl.description: Base URL of the Matrix homeserver. Must be https, or http for a loopback host.

userId.description: Matrix id of the bot account, for example @bot:example.org.

accessTokenSecret.description: Name of the secret holding the bot account's access token.

deviceId.description: Device id of the access token, when the homeserver requires it to be stated.

autoJoin.description: Which room invites the bot accepts: `allowlist` joins only invites from allowed rooms or senders, `never` joins nothing.

allowlist.description: Room ids that may talk to the bot. Empty allows nothing, inbound and outbound.

dmAllowlist.description: Sender ids that may write to the bot in a direct message. Empty allows no direct messages.

signal.description: Signal channel adapter (signal-cli JSON-RPC daemon, reply-code approvals).

enabled.description: Whether the signal channel is started. Off by default; nothing connects until this is true.

account.description: The bot's Signal number in E.164 form, as registered in signal-cli.

endpoint.description: Where the signal-cli JSON-RPC daemon listens. The channel only connects; it never starts signal-cli.

socketPath.description: Unix socket path of the signal-cli daemon. Use this or host and port.

host.description: TCP host of the signal-cli daemon. Non-loopback hosts need allowRemoteEndpoint because the protocol is plaintext.

port.description: TCP port of the signal-cli daemon.

allowRemoteEndpoint.description: Allow a non-loopback TCP endpoint. The JSON-RPC link is unencrypted; only use it on a trusted network.

dmAllowlist.description: Sender ids that may write to the bot in a direct message. Empty allows no direct messages.

locale.description: Language of the bot's own messages (pairing replies, refusals, approval prompts).

email.description: E-mail channel adapter (IMAP/SMTP, reply-code approvals). Addresses and servers are required when enabled.

enabled.description: Whether the email channel is started. Off by default; nothing connects until this is true.

address.description: Mailbox address of the bot; used as From and to recognise its own mail.

displayName.description: Display name used in the From header.

security.description: Transport security: `tls` for implicit TLS, `starttls` for an upgrade before any credential is sent. Plain text is not offered.

passwordSecret.description: Name of the secret holding the IMAP password or app password.

idle.description: Use IMAP IDLE when the server offers it; otherwise, or when false, poll.

pollIntervalSec.description: Seconds between polls when IDLE is not used.

passwordSecret.description: Name of the secret holding the SMTP password or app password.

dmAllowlist.description: Sender addresses that may write to the bot: an exact address or `*@domain`. Empty allows nobody.

maxAttachmentBytes.description: Largest attachment accepted or sent, in bytes.

authServId.description: Authserv-id of the mail server that delivers into the bot mailbox. Only Authentication-Results headers from this server are read; without it every SPF/DKIM/DMARC result counts as none.

requireAuthPass.description: Drop mail whose Authentication-Results do not show a pass (dmarc, or spf and dkim). The channel only reads the verdict; it does not verify mail itself.

voice.description: Voice (D45): cloud voice providers, the local sherpa-onnx fallback, and the simulated local real-time mode. Cloud providers are off until enabled and given a secret reference.

providers.description: Cloud voice providers. API keys are secret-store references (apiKeyRef), never values; Polly uses the AWS default credential chain.

enabled.description: Whether ElevenLabs may be used. Off until enabled and given an apiKeyRef.

apiKeyRef.description: Secret-store reference holding the ElevenLabs API key.

region.description: Data-residency region: default (global), us, eu or in. Ignored when baseUrl is set.

baseUrl.description: Override of the API base URL (https only, or loopback for a local relay).

defaultVoice.description: Voice id used when a request names none.

defaultModel.description: Text-to-speech model id used when a request names none; discovery lists the available ones.

defaultSttModel.description: Speech-to-text model id used when a request names none.

zeroRetention.description: Ask ElevenLabs not to log or retain request content (enable_logging=false), where the account plan allows it.

xai.description: xAI Grok Voice: full-duplex realtime voice, server-side sessions only.

enabled.description: Whether Grok Voice may be used. Off until enabled and given an apiKeyRef.

apiKeyRef.description: Secret-store reference holding the xAI API key.

gemini.description: Google Gemini Live: native-audio realtime voice, server-side sessions only.

defaultModel.description: Live model id used when a session names none; native-audio models are found by discovery when empty.

polly.description: Amazon Polly text-to-speech through the AWS default credential chain (profile, SSO, environment). No keys in config.

enabled.description: Whether Polly may be used. Off until enabled.

region.description: AWS region for Polly; the SDK's own default applies when empty.

credentials.description: Which AWS credentials to use. Only a shared-config profile name is accepted; access keys are refused.

profile.description: Name of the AWS shared-config profile (including SSO profiles); the default chain applies when empty.

defaultModel.description: Polly engine (standard, neural, long-form, generative) used when a request names none.

local.description: Local voice fallback on sherpa-onnx (no account needed): language, quality tier, model directory and the non-commercial licence confirmation.

language.description: Language of the local voice (catalog code such as de or en). Empty: the system language when the catalog has it, else en.

profile.description: Local model tier: fast (streaming recogniser, small voice) or quality (larger models).

profile.description: Local model tier for this agent.

catalogOverride.description: Data that adds or replaces catalog models and languages (adding a language is data, not code). Same shape as the built-in catalog.

modelsDir.description: Directory for downloaded voice models. Empty: a directory under the harness data directory.

acceptNcLicence.description: Confirm that models under non-commercial or unconfirmed licences may be downloaded and used. Off by default; the licence text is shown first.

localRealtime.description: Simulated local real-time voice mode: which optional per-turn features may delay the first audio. Logic only until the voice pipeline is wired.

enabled.description: Whether the local real-time profile applies. When off, every feature runs without a time budget.

endpointingMs.description: Silence after speech, in milliseconds, before the user's turn counts as finished.

speculativeTurnStart.description: Start the agent turn on the final transcript before the silence window ends, and cancel it if the user keeps talking.

ackSound.description: Play a short acknowledgement sound when the user's turn ends.

sentenceChunking.description: How streamed answer text is cut into speakable chunks.

maxWords.description: Maximum words in one spoken chunk; longer sentences are cut at a comma when possible.

features.description: Per-feature mode (on, deferred, off) and optional time budget in milliseconds for features that run before the first audio.

autoRecall.description: Automatic memory recall before the answer.

mode.description: on: runs before the answer within maxMs; deferred: runs after the turn; off: does not run.

drawthings.description: Draw Things, local HTTP API (A1111-compatible txt2img/img2img). Switch on the app's HTTP API server first. Masks are not applied by the app and are refused.

enabled.description: Use Draw Things for image generation.

host.description: Host of the Draw Things API. A host other than loopback also needs `allowLan`.

port.description: Port of the Draw Things API.

allowLan.description: Allow a private-network host (LAN, Tailscale). The traffic is plain http and carries no key.

model.description: Model file name as shown in Draw Things.

timeoutMs.description: Upper bound for one generation in milliseconds.

maxConcurrent.description: How many requests run at once; the app renders one at a time.

coreml.description: Core ML Stable Diffusion through the `media-coreml` helper (macOS, Apple silicon only; build instructions in docs/media-adapters.md).

enabled.description: Use the Core ML helper for image generation.

modelsDir.description: Directory with compiled Core ML model folders (split-einsum or original).

model.description: Name of a model folder inside `modelsDir`.

computeUnits.description: Where inference runs. `auto` lets the helper choose from the model's attention variant (split-einsum: Neural Engine, original: GPU).

scheduler.description: Diffusion scheduler name understood by the helper; unset uses the helper default.

timeoutMs.description: Upper bound for one generation in milliseconds.
